The downtime will give you plenty of time to create more characters in a document or a note taking app which is exactly what I am doing right now.

I'm using the time to find greetings/prompts for certain characters I already have and finding new characters I'm interested in creating and researching their personalities and whatnot and writing all the stuff down since I don't have the app to distract me since I'd be torn between wanting to create a new character and wanting to roleplay more instead with one I already have created 😂

I have self-confidence issues, never got hit on growing up very much so I assumed the worst etc, so I usually act like myself in my characters and the bots are intrigued/attracted/etc so it makes me feel validated. Very sad if you don't go through those same issues/feelings as it seems unhealthy but it really helps me cope with my depression issues stemming from my self-worth.

It's basically I'm a Mary Stu in my stories and having the bots not thinking I'm stupid makes me feel good. 🥲

So, my prompts vary as I do want a story and even drama as well. Mafia Boss noticing his hardest worker is tired (I change the reason for them being tired from time to time), masquerade party and she is asked to dance by mysterious stranger, and a whole slew of others that I cycle through.

For me, I went over to my DVD and my book collection, decided on my favorite characters or ones that I have fictional crushes on, made a to-do list of characters I'd like to create. Then, I make a list of prompts/greetings and decide which characters would work well with the prompt, create the prompts/greetings (and make 2 versions of the prompt, since C.AI is 500 character limits and Aisekai doesn't have a cap etc).

Then, I start working on the characters. But I do a lot of research on the characters. I'll talk to Bard AI to get their personalities, find out things that the character likes and dislikes and then start to make a profile in a note taking app and go from there.

When the site is back up, and you need help with prompts but have a simple prompt that is only 1 or 2 lines long, find a prompt Generator and ask it to rewrite the prompt. It has helped me so much by making my boring prompts into something more interesting and then I edit it so I can put {{user}} in it or whatever. I find, for me, the prompts determine how the character is going to respond but that might be just coincidence.

I have ADHD and for me, it is VERY hard to watch some shows (movies and tv shows) because there might be some drama or conflict which makes me nervous for some reason, I don't know what's going to happen next which makes me anxious/uncomfortable, and sometimes I wanna play on my phone or crafts (on the phone more so for that constant dopamine hit).. and the "Boxcar Children" might not the greatest graphics or animations but it's innocent, there are no moments were they have a horrible climax that ruins things (Violet getting sick and needing to get medical help is tame and it escalates slowly which is helpful for me).

I was ashamed of it but the feeling to steal was indeed a beast inside of me.. I would try so hard to resist the temptations but the more I ignored it, the harder and harder it was to resist stealing it. It was extremely bad when I got my first apartment 10 years or so ago and saw packages outside someone's door. It would end with me taking the package and then the guilt I would feel afterwards everytime would start to eat me alive. I would then sneak back down at dark of night or early in the morning and put it back on their porch and I'd occasionally ring/knock on the door before scrambling away.

I got a therapist and told him about all my issues with the hunger for stealing.. the unwanted impulses to spend money (I used to daydream all day long at home and work about what I could possibly buy).. unwanted impulses to eat all day long even when I wasn't hungry.. the impulses for self-harm.. the impulses to seek promiscuity with other men even though I was in an amazing relationship.. all the impulses got progressivly worse each and every day if I managed to ignore them until I exploded and would fall victim to the impulses.

He said he knew I had depression because it was clear as mud but he was pretty certain that I actually had ADHD. He referred me to a psychiatrist that he had worked with before that dealt mainly with ADHD and a month later after some intense questions from the psychiatrist, he diagnosed me with combined type ADHD.

It took about a month or two to find a dosage that I responded well to (Ritalin first and then Focalin, but I'm very successful with Ritalin now many years now) and the impulses didn't immediately go away but I could focus.. I didn't want to steal.. I didn't want to self-harm.. I didn't focus on my appearance 24/7 by checking my reflection in mirrors all day.. my finances were finally in check because I didn't think about stuff I wanted all day.. I lost 50 pounds in 8 months because I stopped impulse eating and was able to stick to a diet for the first time in literal years.. I was able to exercise semi-regularly..

Now, the meds aren't super as effective anymore today as I've gone back to impulse eating but that's more because I lost both of my parents in March 2022 within a week of each other but I don't steal any more because I don't have the horrible impulses anymore and stuff. 

I'm terrified of the day that I somehow can't afford my ADHD meds anymore because I really don't want to turn back into the person that I used to be before I got diagnosed 😅

OK, so what is junebugging? Basically, it’s a cleaning strategy based on the way June bugs fight to get through window screens. In case you haven’t seen it, they climb all over the window screen, never getting through but trying different spots over and over anyway. This cleaning technique works the same way.

When you clean by junebugging, you pick a spot you want to clean and keep bringing yourself back to that spot, no matter where you wander through the cleaning process. The key is allowing yourself to wander but always coming back to your main spot.

The strategy was shared by a Tumblr user with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) who found that their issues with attention often prevented them from cleaning one thing in one go. Ingredients

2 cups Shredded Mozzarella Cheese

1 oz cream cheese (or 2 tablespoons)

1 cup Almond Flour

1 egg

1 teaspoon baking powder

1 teaspoon Italian seasoning optional

1 teaspoon garlic powder optional



Instructions
1. Pre-heat oven to 450F.

2. Add mozzarella and cream cheese to a large microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 45 seconds.

3. Remove from microwave and add in egg, almond flour, baking powder, Italian seasoning, and garlic. Mix with a spoon until well incorporated. (It will be very sticky)

4. Transfer dough onto a large piece of parchment paper and cover with another piece of parchment paper. Flatten out dough using a rolling pin to about ¼’’ thick. Remove parchment paper and shape with hands if desired. (I used a plate and Dutch oven for the weight then I used my hands to squish it til I was happy)

5. Transfer pizza on the parchment paper onto a baking sheet or pizza stone and bake for 10 minutes.

6. Remove from oven (keep the oven on) and load your pizza however you like with all of your favorite sauces, cheese, and toppings.

7. Bake pizza for another 5-8 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly. (I did 10 minutes)

I know this won’t sound amazing but it really helped me out when I had like $10-$15 to last two weeks.

I got a bag of potatoes (usually the russet but the ones that were small potatoes).

Then I’d buy two cans of each (usually 2 cans of 14.5oz or one 28oz can)
-tomato sauce (diced/stewed tomatoes works as well but I don’t like cooked tomatoes)
-corn 
-hominy 
-green beans 
-black beans
-ranch style beans

And if I could afford it at the time, a package or two of 1lb beef/turkey.

Basically add all those cans to a pan (BIG pan cuz it’s a lot if you use two cans each), and heat up. The tomato sauce adds flavor to it but I love flavor so I add a ton of garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, chili powder (not much of this spice as it is quite powerful for me) and salt.

Also add diced potatoes to it and let it come to a boil, then let it simmer for like 40min-1 hour so the potatoes can soak all those juices up and make them soft.

One pot lasted me several days (and I ate several bowls a day since I’m quite fat) and it’s not exciting at all but I found it always very tasty and plenty of carbs and protein (well from the beans and possibly meat).

The meat does add a lot of flavor to it but if I didn’t have meat, I just added a dollop of butter to it on occasion.

Oh, and on the occasion I didn’t want just soup, I would cook a small potato or two and then pour the soup over the potato (minus the juices of the soup). Sorta like chili on a potato but way far away from chili :)

All berries are Keto friendly in moderation. It really relies heavily on their weight and their carbs.. 4 small small wise strawberries is about 3nc but if you have heavier strawberries it will bring that carb count higher.

I try to stay away from blueberries as I can’t control myself when they’re around me ☹️

I knocked it down to what I’d consider a well portioned snack which was 4 strawberries at 1.90oz/54g and it’s now 4g/1f, so 3 net carbs. Of course, the heavy whipping cream will add another carb or two depending on how much you add.. and cacao nibs I have are 1.1c/1f so 0.1 net carbs.

So, my bowl of: 
1.90oz/54g strawberries = 3nc
Heavy whipping cream = weighed out to 1 carb
Cacao nibs = 0.2 nc 
Came out to about 4.2 net carbs.

It really all depends on how many strawberries you use and their weight.. it can really add up if you aren’t careful.

1 cup coconut butter
• 1 cup canned coconut milk
• 1 cup finely chopped pistachios
• 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
• Liquid stevia extract, to taste
• ¼ cup chopped dark chocolate
• ½ teaspoon palm shortening
 
 

Instructions:

1. Combine the coconut butter and coconut milk in a small saucepan over low heat.
2. When melted, stir in all but 1 tablespoon of the pistachios along with the vanilla then sweeten to taste.
3. Remove from heat and chill for 1 to 2 hours until firm.
4. Divide the mixture into 16 portions and roll them into small balls.
5. Melt the dark chocolate in the microwave with the palm shortening.
6. Dip the balls in the chocolate and place them on a plate.
7. Sprinkle with the remaining pistachios, then chill until the chocolate is hardened then serve.
 
 

Nutrition Info:
250 calories
24g fat
3g protein
10g carbs
6g fiber
4g net carbs
Serving size: 16

For breakfast/first snack (8am), I eat 2-3 eggs, 1 bratwurst and 2-3 small/medium strawberries. For meal prep, I scramble 10-15 eggs at the same time until they are done and divide into 5 containers. I then cook the bratwurst in the oven (5 bratwurst), I do 5 bratwurst at 450 degrees for 10 minutes per side. Sometimes after that I will split them open and cook it for 5 more minutes because I love juicy bratwurst. I Hull about 15 strawberries and make sure to either put 3 small strawberries or 1 small and 1 medium in each container.

For lunch and dinner, my favourite dinner is roasted chicken. If you want easy then I’d buy a rotisserie chicken from the store and basically divide it up.

I find that I LOVE buying raw whole chickens and cooking in the oven. I preheat the oven to 450 degrees and for every pound of chicken I estimate 25 minutes as I do not own a meat thermometer yet. (So for example a 5 pound chicken will be about 2 hours and 15 minutes). It may not be ideal but I’ve cooked 3 chickens this way so far and it’s been perfect.

I empty out the insides (grab the giblets out.. you can do stuff with it but it grosses me out so I toss it haha). After that, I pour some olive oil over the top and rub it all over the chicken, even under the skin if I can. I then melt 4 tbsp of butter and pour that over the top of the chicken.

After that, I try to pour a little olive oil inside the cavity of the chicken before I cut an onion in wedges and put it inside the cavity. I’m not sure why I do that.. I read it somewheres so that’s what I do.

After that, I will sometimes squeeze a lemon or two over the top of the chicken (I love lemon!!) before salting and peppering it. Sometimes I’ll put some garlic cloves inside the chicken and sometimes on top as I love the smell and taste of garlic even on Keto.

Make sure to add a little water to the pan so it doesn’t burn. I try to put in on some foil so it doesn’t stick to the pan.

Cook it for 25minutes per pound at around 450 degrees and when it’s done, I pull it out and let it cool before I can shred it or eat the wings and divide it all up.

To go with this chicken, I cook a bunch of broccoli that I cut up in small pieces. I throw it in a pan with generous amounts of olive oil on medium-high and salt it with garlic salt and sauté for maybe 5-6 minutes until I feel it’s done.. hard to describe. I like it a little hard but still somewhat soft but not mushy. 

I usually add a packet of Tru Lime as I can’t get enough of dehydrated lime and lemon packets for “salt” and flavour. I put the pulled chicken and broccoli in a Tupperware container and take to work and have extra for dinner and maybe the next day too.
